content: Rilpivirine is indicated for use in combination with other antiretroviral agents for the treatment of HIV-1 infection in treatment-naïve adult patients with HIV-1 RNA levels below 100,000 copies/mL. The recommended dose is 25 mg orally once daily, administered with a meal. Rilpivirine is also indicated in combination with cabotegravir as a complete regimen for short-term treatment of HIV-1 infection in adults who are virologically suppressed (HIV-1 RNA < 50 copies/mL) on a stable antiretroviral therapy regimen, with no history of treatment failure and no known or suspected resistance to either cabotegravir or rilpivirine. Rilpivirine is indicated for use in combination with other antiretroviral agents for the treatment of HIV-1 infection in treatment-naïve adolescents aged 2 years or older with HIV-1 RNA levels ≤ 100,000 copies/mL. Carbamazepine decreases rilpivirine levels by inducing hepatic and intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration is contraindicated as it may result in loss of virologic response and potential resistance to rilpivirine or the NNRTI class.
